ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, point D is located on side AC, point E is located on side CB; segment DE connects D and E. The pink arrow marks in the figure show that DE is parallel to AB. Reasoning: Because DE ∥ AB, triangle CDE and triangle CAB are similar. From the corresponding sides of similar triangles being proportional, obtain CE/CB = CD/CA. It is known that CE = t - 2, EB = t + 1, so CB = CE + EB = (t - 2) + (t + 1) = 2t - 1. Also CD = 2, CA = 10, therefore (t - 2)/(2t - 1) = 2/10. Simplify to (t - 2)/(2t - 1) = 1/5, cross-multiplying gives 5(t - 2) = 2t - 1, that is, 5t - 10 = 2t - 1, so 3t = 9, t = 3.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: D is between C and A on side AC, E is between C and B on side CB, and DE is marked parallel to AB. From the text, CD=2 and CA=10, so DA=CA-CD=8. By the side-splitter theorem, the parallel segment DE divides the two sides proportionally, so CE/EB = CD/DA. Substitute CE=t-2 and EB=t+1 to get (t-2)/(t+1)=2/8=1/4. Solve 4(t-2)=t+1, giving t=3.

推理：由题给 CD=2，CA=10，所以 DA=CA-CD=10-2=8。因为 DE ∥ AB，根据平行线分线段成比例定理，CE/EB=CD/DA。代入 CE=t-2，EB=t+1，得到 (t-2)/(t+1)=2/8=1/4。解方程：4(t-2)=t+1，所以 4t-8=t+1，3t=9，t=3。
